summary: Examples show /etc/hosts is not a vaulted file while a vaulted file path is.
questions: How do I use vaulted_file in a var?

answer_card.title: vaulted_file test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
thisisfalse: '{{ "/etc/hosts" is vaulted_file }}'
thisistrue: '{{ "/path/to/vaulted/file" is vaulted_file }}'
```
